utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s just the repair drive list—I’m keeping track of where each item needs to go. I can read you the locations one by one if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please do — one by one sounds perfect. I don’t want to miss where anything goes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Bo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — could you just help sort the donations and keep an eye on the drop-off table?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and watch the drop-off table.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Rey — thank you. Could you help me make a quick list of the repairs we need and reach out to a few neighbors who might want to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can make the list and talk to a few neighbors who might help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive was getting a good bit of support—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, it’s picking up nicely. I’ve been a bit swamped, but I can check the latest and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo—that’d be great. I’m relying on second-hand news, so just let me know when you’ve got the latest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So what’s the first thing you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we still need a few more tools and maybe some spare screws—sorry, my list’s a bit messy. I’ll check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you send me the list as soon as you check? I can help fill in anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now. If there’s a simple task for the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — can you help sort donated screws and nails into small boxes?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can do that quietly. Drop them off and I’ll sort them when I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for checking—I've only heard bits and pieces, so let me know if you hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll ask around and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and make a quick list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by a bit later and help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll have the list ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Noah — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — could you start by sorting the repair list and checking who still needs to be contacted?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the repair list and check who still needs to be contacted first. I’ll let you know what’s left to reach out about.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is kicking off soon, and folks are already lining up tools and supplies. If you want, I can pass along the details as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and whether we have enough space for everything. If you tell me the plan, I can help sort out the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll lay out the plan again, and then we can check the timing and space together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that would help. If you can share the timing and what’s being hauled, I can figure out the space we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that—where should I note the repair drive location?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks! Put it at the community hall on Maple Street—it’ll help everyone find it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note the community hall on Maple Street for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations and keep an eye on the sign-in table? I’ll swing by with the list in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations and watch the sign-in table until you get here.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I’m a bit all over the place today. I’m happy to help if you need anything packed up or carried over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — could you help keep an eye on the boxes and maybe check the list so we don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I can do that — boxes and list, got it. Just point me where to stand and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like a clear plan for the repair drive. If you tell me what needs doing, I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’ll lay it out clearly, and we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That suits me fine. Just tell me the first job, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m putting together a little repair drive and wanted to invite you—could really use another friendly pair of hands. If you’re free, swing by and I’ll fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, that sounds good—I can stop by. Just let me know what time and what you need help with.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! How about this Saturday at 10? Mostly sorting donations and helping neighbors carry a few things, so any extra hands would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking the repair drive could be a great way to get everyone pitching in together. Want to help me figure out what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe — but are we sure we know what’s left to get?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good point — let’s make a quick checklist so we’re not guessing. We can start with the basics and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. We’ve still got the leaky faucet, the loose porch step, and a few lamps to check—let’s start with the faucet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—show me the faucet and I’ll grab the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the repair drive still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still happening today. I’ll head over later with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks for confirming. What time are you planning to come by?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive. What time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a huge help, Faye. I was thinking late afternoon, maybe 4 to 6, so folks can stop by after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 to 6 should work for me. I can help spread the word and line up the school pickup crowd.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is really picking up — what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: A few things still need a hand — mostly sorting tools, checking donations, and making sure the last repairs get matched with the right people.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help sort the tools and check the donations if you’d like. That should make it easier to match the last repairs up სწორly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what kind of repairs you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I need help with a small roof leak and a loose front gate. I’m free this Saturday around 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ve got a small roof leak and a loose front gate for this Saturday around 10 AM. I’ll check the details and follow up if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — we still need help sorting donated tools, checking the sign-up sheet, and setting up the tables. Could you take one of those?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take the donated tools. I’ll sort them and keep an eye out for anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand and bring over any tools we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — can you double-check which tools you’re bringing so we don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, tape measure, pliers, and my drill with bits. If you want, I can also grab a step ladder and extra screws.
